Name: Fish Sauce
Author: Agentbla
Description:
[size=2]Always felt like fishing benefitted very little from machines, especially once Y2 rolls around and the coal price doubles.
Soo I decided to make a new artisan good, fish sauce.

Fish sauce takes seven days to age in a preserving jar, but has a 4x price multiplier compared to a smoked fish's 2x, while not requiring coal. It also inherits the original fish's quality and profits from the Fisher and Angler profession's, just like smokers.

You can also create a special version that is made using the most common fish used in fish sauce in real life, anchovies.

Probably incompatible with:
- Mods that add another recipe using fish and the preserving jar.[/size]
